Fig1.en: Separate study branches and recoverable image units. (a) Post hoc controlled sibling-exposure experiment in the four-class augmented COLD archive. Each of 30 prespecified seeds assigns 163 families to probe P, 82 to sentinel S, and 571 to the initial training set D. At nominal exposure fractions 0, 0.5 and 1, two non-anchor views from selected P families replace two views from matched same-class training families. Within each seed, the 245 test anchors, 1,142-file training budget, 571 training families and training class counts remain fixed; every included training family contributes two views. All S-family images are excluded from every training condition. (b) Separate binary TOM2024-to-raw-COLD analysis using acquisition-day-grouped nested fitting and TOM-only calibration and threshold selection before locked external evaluation. The branches use different endpoints and are not successive rungs of one nested validation cohort. (c) Distributed files and filename-defined families by augmented COLD label. Filename families and acquisition days do not identify independent plants or plots
Fig1.zh: 两个独立研究分支及可恢复的图像单位。（a）增强COLD四分类档案中的事后受控兄弟暴露实验。每个预先固定的随机种子将163个家族划入探针集P、82个家族划入哨兵集S、571个家族划入初始训练集D，共30个种子。在名义暴露比例0、0.5和1下，以选中P家族的两张非测试衍生图像替换同类别匹配训练家族的两张图像。同一种子内，245张测试锚点图像、1,142张训练图像、571个训练家族及训练类别计数均保持一致，每个纳入训练的家族贡献两张图像。所有S家族图像始终不进入训练。（b）独立的TOM2024至原始COLD二分类分析：按采集日分组进行嵌套拟合，仅用TOM确定校准及阈值，随后锁定外部评价。两分支的终点不同，并非同一嵌套验证队列的连续层级。（c）按增强COLD标签统计的发布文件数与文件名定义家族数。文件名家族和采集日不代表已确认的独立植株或地块

Fig2.en: Controlled sibling exposure under fixed test composition and training budget. (a, b) Four-class balanced accuracy for the fixed probe anchors P and always-unexposed sentinel anchors S using frozen ResNet18 features and colour features, respectively. At each seed, nominal fractions 0, 0.5 and 1 correspond to 0, 81 and 163 P families exposed through two training siblings; 0.5 is realized as 81/163. P and S anchors, the 1,142 training files, 571 training families and per-class training counts remain fixed across conditions. (c) Full-exposure-minus-clean balanced-accuracy changes paired within seed, shown separately for P and S. (d) The paired change in P minus the paired change in S at half and full exposure. Markers are means over all 30 prespecified seeds; intervals are the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles across seeds, describing split variability rather than confidence intervals over independent biological samples. The post hoc replacement diagnostic changes training family identity and dependence; it is neither new external validation nor an estimate of the separate binary source-transfer gap
Fig2.zh: 固定测试组成与训练预算下的受控兄弟暴露。（a、b）分别采用冻结ResNet18特征和颜色特征，对固定探针锚点P及始终未暴露的哨兵锚点S计算四分类平衡准确率。每个种子下，名义比例0、0.5和1分别对应0、81和163个P家族通过两张训练兄弟图像暴露，其中0.5实际为81/163。不同条件使用完全相同的P、S锚点，训练图像数1,142、训练家族数571及各类别训练计数均固定。（c）逐种子配对计算的完全暴露减零暴露平衡准确率差，分别显示P和S。（d）半暴露和完全暴露条件下，P的配对变化减S的配对变化。点为全部30个预先固定种子的均值；区间为跨种子的第2.5及97.5百分位，描述划分变异，而非基于独立生物样本的置信区间。该事后替换诊断改变训练家族身份和依赖关系，不构成新的外部验证，也不估计独立二分类源间迁移差距
